title: Resend webhook verification throws even though the signing secret is correct
symptoms: Svix verify fails with No matching signature found
Works with the raw curl payload, fails inside the framework route
cause: The svix-signature header signs the exact raw body, and frameworks that parse JSON and re-serialize it change the bytes.
fix: Read the body as text before any JSON parser and pass that string with the svix-id, svix-timestamp, and svix-signature headers.
apply: const payload = await req.text(); const event = resend.webhooks.verify({ payload, headers: { id: req.headers.get('svix-id'), timestamp: req.headers.get('svix-timestamp'), signature: req.headers.get('svix-signature') }, webhookSecret: WEBHOOK_SECRET });
affected: Resend webhooks (Svix signed), Next.js route handlers and Express with express.json(), as of 2026-10
